name: datahub-memory
description: Grounded, self-correcting memory for DataHub — a memory layer, not an agent. Exposes five MCP tools (memory_recall, memory_persist, check_freshness, writeback_description, writeback_report) backed by delapan's write-time resolver, so any agent has somewhere to put what it concludes, grounded in DataHub URNs and deterministically re-verified when the catalog moves under it. Three skills consume it: /datahub-memory:investigate (the flagship — recall first, walk lineage/schemas/documents only where memory is thin, persist, write back), /datahub-memory:recall (memory-only lookup with the freshness check), and /datahub-memory:writeback (record a conclusion onto the entity itself). Backed by two MCP servers: memory (this layer, local tier) and datahub (mcp-server-datahub).
